source: User-supplied Wave Race 64 USA revision 1 ROM on VENGEANCE
method: Original ADPCM decoding of sequence0/channel12 regular announcer percussion, logical bank2 resolving to physical bank2. Its112 drum slots contain95 populated selectors and17 null entries, rendered to94 standalone mono PCM files with one shared clip. Special127 uses logical/physical bank6:27 additional files across30 drum slots, with null14/15/29. Its30 sequence selectors include timed multi-part speech, legato pan movement, an empty selector28 and selector29's drum28. Special126 remains unimplemented. The ROM and raw banks remain private.
tools: Existing REA/Ghidra analysis on EVO X2
mix: Source tuning is baked into32kHz PCM without peak normalization. Original envelope uses two approximate7.5ms attack steps; clips are bounded by7.5seconds plus approximate150ms release and5ms end fade. All admitted samples naturally end before that limit. Regular speech is centered. Menu selectors16..25 start their preface after140 ticks and replace it135 ticks later;26/27 retain one sample across source pan changes. Explicit waits plus the following6-tick poll coalesce pending IO0 writes. C377C arguments and legato allocation are checked with original MIPS; menu plans are checked against sequence bytecode. Web Audio schedules those offsets, while ordinary delivery follows browser drains rather than the sequencer polling phase. Original reverb and release tails at forced layer replacement are not emulated. Stereo/headphone width, bus gain and resampling are browser adaptations. Missing files do not produce substitute speech or replay after loading.
